title: On the Evaluation of Neural Code Translation: Taxonomy and Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Categorizing code translation tasks into a taxonomy of four levels of increasing complexity (token, syntax, library, and algorithm) and analyzing model performance across these levels to demonstrate that existing benchmarks over-represent simple, trivial translations.
Manually rephrasing code samples and standardizing naming conventions according to the Google style guide to mitigate benchmark evaluation biases toward specific programming styles.
